result.instructions: Tools for Eventee, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show me the program for the second day of the conference."; "Which sessions got the best ratings, and what did people comment on the lowest-rated ones?"; "Who has registered but is still pending, and who has not checked in yet?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Eventee data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run eventee_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run eventee_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run eventee_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. eventee_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: eventee_get_program
tools.title: Get event program
tools.description: The whole program of the event the API token belongs to: halls, event days, sessions (`lectures`, type 0), workshops (type 1, with capacity and bookings), breaks (`pauses`), speakers and labels (`tracks`). Use it to read back ids (hall_id, speaker ids, label ids, session ids) before changing anything. Replies are compact: long texts are clipped (description_max), each part is paged (limit/offset, `more` maps each part with further rows to the offset to continue from; the reply is cut to a size budget, so for big events read one part at a time with `parts`) and `parts` selects what to read. Times are in the event's time zone. GET /public/api/v1/content.

date.description: Only this day's program (yyyy-mm-dd). Days without content return empty lists.

with_overlapping.description: Also list event days that have no content yet in `days`.

parts.description: Only these parts (default: all): halls, days, sessions, workshops, breaks, speakers, labels.

offset.description: Rows to skip in every part (default 0); With several parts the offset applies to all of them: page a big event one part at a time.

description_max.description: Characters kept of each description / speaker bio (default 300). Raise it to read a full text.

tools.name: eventee_list_participants
tools.title: List participants
tools.description: Participants of the event (attendees, speakers, moderators, admins) with role, group, tickets, check-in time and registration time. `role`: a = admin, m = moderator, l = speaker, e = attendee. `checked_at` is null until checked in. Anonymous participants and deleted accounts have a placeholder email without '@'. The personal app link of each participant is not returned. Filters apply after the full list is read; use limit/offset for large events. GET /public/api/v1/participants.

search.description: Keep participants whose name, email or company contains this text.

group_id.description: Only this attendee group (ids from eventee_list_groups).

checked_in.description: true = only checked-in people, false = only those not yet checked in.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: eventee_list_registrations
tools.title: List registrations
tools.description: Registrations of the event (people who registered or were pre-registered) with status (pending / confirmed / declined), group, contact details and registration-form answers. Filters apply after the full list is read; use limit/offset for large events. GET /public/api/v1/registrations.

search.description: Keep registrations whose name, email or company contains this text.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: eventee_list_groups
tools.title: List attendee groups
tools.description: Attendee groups of the event with the app features enabled for each (agenda, questions, polling, networking, ratings, ...), the ticket names that put people into the group automatically, and which group is the default. Use the ids as group_id when inviting or registering people. GET /public/api/v1/groups.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: eventee_list_reviews
tools.title: List session reviews
tools.description: Session ratings left by attendees (1-5 stars with optional comment), each with the rated session, plus a per-session summary (count and average stars; the 50 most reviewed sessions, `summary_truncated` says if more exist: use session_id for a specific one). Filters apply after the full list is read. GET /public/api/v1/reviews.

session_id.description: Only reviews of this session (id from eventee_get_program).

min_stars.description: Only reviews with at least this many stars.

max_stars.description: Only reviews with at most this many stars.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: eventee_list_partners
tools.title: List partners
tools.description: Partners (sponsors and exhibitors) of the event with company details, contact data, code and page sections. GET /public/api/v1/partners.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: eventee_create_session
tools.title: Create session
tools.description: WRITE: add a session (lecture or workshop) to the event program. It appears in the event app for attendees. The event day is taken from `start` and created if missing. The hall, speakers and labels must already exist (create them first and pass their ids). POST /public/api/v1/lecture.

start.description: Local time in the event's time zone, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss' (e.g. 2026-06-01 09:00:00).

end.description: Local time in the event's time zone, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss' (e.g. 2026-06-01 09:00:00).

moderating.description: Questions need moderator approval first. Default false.

capacity.description: Seats for a workshop (bookable). Default 0; only applies to workshops.

stream_url.description: Live stream URL (YouTube, Vimeo, Twitch, Zoom...).

virtual_meeting_url.description: Virtual meeting URL attendees can join (Zoom, Google Meet...).

checkin.description: Enable attendee check-in at the session (workshops only). Default false.

tools.name: eventee_update_session
tools.title: Update session
tools.description: WRITE: replace a session (full update, not a patch). Eventee RESETS what is omitted: speakers, labels, type, capacity and the Q&A / moderation / polling switches, so `type`, `speaker_ids`, `label_ids`, `capacity`, `discussion`, `moderating` and `polling` are required here; read the session first with eventee_get_program and pass its current values (an empty list removes all). The hall and live stream are kept when omitted. `start` must fall on an existing day of the event. PATCH /public/api/v1/lecture/{session_id}.

start.description: Local time in the event's time zone, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss' (e.g. 2026-06-01 09:00:00).

end.description: Local time in the event's time zone, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss' (e.g. 2026-06-01 09:00:00).

discussion.description: Attendee questions (Q&A) on/off (required: omitted = off). Pass the current value.

moderating.description: Questions need moderator approval (required: omitted = off). Pass the current value.

polling.description: Live polls on/off (required: omitted = off). Pass the current value.

capacity.description: Workshop seats (required: an omitted capacity is reset to 0); pass the current value, 0 for a lecture.

stream_url.description: Live stream URL (YouTube, Vimeo, Twitch, Zoom...).

virtual_meeting_url.description: Virtual meeting URL attendees can join (Zoom, Google Meet...).

type.description: lecture or workshop (required: an omitted type turns a workshop into a lecture).

speaker_ids.description: Speaker ids in display order; [] removes all speakers.

tools.name: eventee_delete_session
tools.title: Delete session
tools.description: WRITE, IRREVERSIBLE: delete a session (lecture or workshop) together with its questions, polls, workshop bookings and ratings. Needs confirm: true (without it: a preview, nothing deleted). DELETE /public/api/v1/lecture/{session_id}.

confirm.description: Must be true to run. Without it nothing is changed and a preview is returned; ask the user to approve first.

tools.name: eventee_create_hall
tools.title: Create hall
tools.description: WRITE: add a hall (room, stage or virtual space) to the event. Use the returned id as hall_id for sessions. POST /public/api/v1/hall.

order.description: Position in the agenda (0 = first). Default: the end.

tools.name: eventee_create_break
tools.title: Create break
tools.description: WRITE: add a break (coffee, lunch...) to the event program on the day of `start` (created if missing). POST /public/api/v1/pause.

start.description: Local time in the event's time zone, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss' (e.g. 2026-06-01 09:00:00).

end.description: Local time in the event's time zone, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss' (e.g. 2026-06-01 09:00:00).

tools.name: eventee_create_label
tools.title: Create label
tools.description: WRITE: add a label (track) for sessions, with a colour. Use the returned id in label_ids of a session. POST /public/api/v1/label.

color.description: Colour as a hex code, e.g. #3B82F6.

order.description: Position in lists (0 = first). Default: the end.

tools.name: eventee_create_speaker
tools.title: Create speaker
tools.description: WRITE: add a speaker profile to the event (shown in the event app). Use the returned id in speaker_ids of a session. The photo, if given, is downloaded by Eventee from the URL. POST /public/api/v1/speaker.

language.description: Language the speaker presents in (e.g. en, cs).

tools.name: eventee_invite_attendees
tools.title: Invite attendees
tools.description: WRITE: add up to 100 people to the event as attendees, optionally with a group and tickets. People who already have an Eventee account are added directly; others get a profile that links when they sign up with the same email. With send_email=true Eventee SENDS AN INVITATION EMAIL to every person listed (default false: no email); sending needs confirm: true (without it: a preview, nothing sent or added). Invalid entries and the event's admins/moderators are skipped silently by Eventee, so re-read eventee_list_participants to confirm. The first 25 are processed immediately, the rest in the background. Tickets replace the person's existing tickets. PUT /public/api/v1/attendee/invite.

group_id.description: Attendee group for this person (overrides the default group_id).

tickets.description: Tickets of the person (replace existing ones).

type.description: How the ticket number is displayed.

group_id.description: Default attendee group for people without their own group_id (eventee_list_groups).

send_email.description: Send each person the invitation email. Default false. Needs confirm: true.

confirm.description: Required (true) only with send_email=true. Without it nothing is sent or added and a preview is returned; ask the user to approve the recipients first.

tools.name: eventee_register_people
tools.title: Pre-register people
tools.description: WRITE: pre-register up to 100 people for the event (an existing registration with the same email is updated, not duplicated). With send_email=true Eventee SENDS A REGISTRATION EMAIL to every person listed (default false: no email); sending needs confirm: true (without it: a preview, nothing sent or registered). Invalid entries are skipped silently by Eventee, so re-read eventee_list_registrations to confirm. PUT /public/api/v1/registration/invite.

group_id.description: Attendee group for this person (overrides the default group_id).
Default attendee group for people without their own group_id (eventee_list_groups).

send_email.description: Send each person the registration email. Default false. Needs confirm: true.

confirm.description: Required (true) only with send_email=true. Without it nothing is sent or registered and a preview is returned; ask the user to approve the recipients first.

tools.name: eventee_check_in_attendee
tools.title: Check in attendee
tools.description: WRITE: check a participant in at the event (sets checked_at to now) or undo the check-in. Use the participant `id` from eventee_list_participants. Fails if the person is not a participant of the event. PATCH /public/api/v1/attendee/{attendee_id}/checkin.

checkin.description: true = check in, false = undo the check-in.

tools.name: eventee_remove_attendee
tools.title: Remove attendee
tools.description: WRITE, IRREVERSIBLE: remove the person with this email from the event: their participation, invitation and tickets for this event are deleted (their Eventee account is not). Eventee reports success even when nobody had that email. Needs confirm: true (without it: a preview, nothing removed). DELETE /public/api/v1/attendee?email=.

email.description: Email of the attendee to remove.

confirm.description: Must be true to run. Without it nothing is changed and a preview is returned; ask the user to approve first.

tools.name: eventee_remove_registration
tools.title: Remove registration
tools.description: WRITE, IRREVERSIBLE: delete the registration with this email. Eventee reports success even when no such registration exists. Needs confirm: true (without it: a preview, nothing deleted). DELETE /public/api/v1/registration?email=.

email.description: Email of the registration to delete.

confirm.description: Must be true to run. Without it nothing is changed and a preview is returned; ask the user to approve first.

prompts.title: Get started with Eventee
